description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/flux_limiter_minmod_D_inflow_bc driven by problems/advection_1d_inflow_minmod.esm (model AdvectionMinmodInflow), loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) -- no per-resolution fixture files. The manufactured steady solution cos(pi x) is held by the exact forcing c dGdx with left inflow gL = u*(0) = 1 (derivation and the inflow/outflow-compatibility argument in the problem file). cos(pi x) is smooth and monotone on [0,1], so the minmod limiter is INACTIVE in the interior (second-order there), and the boundary faces -- though a FORMALLY first-order closure (the prescribed inflow flux gL, the extrapolated outflow) -- carry only higher-order residuals for THIS compatible MMS because the exact inflow value is supplied and the wall gradient u*_x is zero at both walls. The OBSERVED order is therefore close to the design second order, norm-dependent: the Julia golden gives pairwise L2 orders [1.80, 1.88, 1.94] (median 1.88) and Linf [1.56, 1.76, 1.95] (median 1.76) over N=16..128, both approaching 2 from below. expected_order 1.8 with the standard-ish order_tolerance 0.2 brackets both norm medians; the numbers are read from the Julia sweep, not forced.
